# waelkabli.com — Wael A. Kabli
# Serial Tech Entrepreneur, Digital Health Pioneer, Strategic Advisor & Speaker

## About
Wael A. Kabli (وائل كابلي) is a Saudi serial tech entrepreneur, founder and CEO of Cura —
Saudi Arabia's first virtual hospital and #1 telehealth platform with 4M+ users and $7M raised.
He is a Misk 2030 Leader, Forbes Middle East Healthcare Innovation Circle member, and strategic
advisor to government entities, C-suite executives, and international organizations on digital
transformation, healthcare technology, and Vision 2030.

Executive education: Columbia University, Stanford University, INSEAD, ESADE, Babson College, KFUPM.
Based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
